## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you'd like to see added.

## Problem It Solves
Is your feature request related to a specific challenge during interviews or workflow issues? 
*(e.g., "I struggle with quick shortcut toggles during system design rounds...")*

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working inside the desktop overlay.

## Alternative Solutions Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workaround features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any relevant mockups, examples, or screenshots here.
